sentences.text: The scheme pfeslpbtac stands for the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana.
It was launched to provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of crop failure due to natural calamities.
The main objective is to stabilize the income of farmers and encourage them to adopt modern agricultural practices.
The scheme offers benefits such as coverage for crop loss due to adverse weather conditions pests and diseases.
Farmers can receive compensation based on the area and extent of crop loss.
Eligibility is primarily for all farmers who grow notified crops in the notified areas.
Farmers must pay a nominal premium which varies based on the type of crop.
The application process involves farmers enrolling through their respective state governments or insurance companies.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
It operates on a seasonal basis with applications typically invited before the sowing season.
The scheme is available across all states and Union Territories in India.
The premium subsidy is provided by the central and state governments.
Farmers can claim benefits through the insurance companies designated by the state government.
